title: Small-coupling optimizing rectangles stay in a common nondegenerate compact set

shape_space.parameterization: C_alpha=product_i[-alpha_i,alpha_i] inside [-1,1]^3, with 0<alpha_i<=1 and degenerate faces adjoined
shape_space.boundary: R_0=ell_0^2/tau_0 and S_0=ell_0^3/tau_0^2 extend continuously by zero on every degenerate face
shape_space.profile_rate: K1571 gives g log(1/kappa_g)->1/(12pi), and the weighted integrals converge uniformly beyond every algebraic order needed for the cubic expansion.

compactness.maximizer_set: Mset={C:R_0(C)=M} is compact and disjoint from the degenerate boundary
compactness.near_minimizers: Every exact or o(g^2)-near scalar-envelope minimizer lies in one common compact interior neighborhood of Mset for sufficiently small g.

scope_guard: This compactness is for centered axis-aligned K1683 rectangles and the K1572 small-coupling profile; it does not cover arbitrary nonrectangular or cutoff-dependent packet geometries.
